name: Stardust Dreamers
source:
Transfer student Ichiko Popopokopo is "out there" in more ways than one, if you catch my drift. Join her as she sets out to start her new school life at the famed Zealgood Academy, a school of creation and passions of all kinds. Ichiko's not exactly local, but that's just made her all the more eager to do her best so she can achieve her dreams.

Make friends, make movies, and more! What awaits Ichiko in The Alien of The Occult Club? That all depends on you! 

[From [url=https://rosegardengames.itch.io/the-alien-of-the-occult-club] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
转校生一子·波波波波波在各个方面都很“超然”，如果你懂我的意思。加入她，开启在著名泽尔古德学院的新校园生活；这是一所创造与各种激情的学校。一子并非本地人，但这只让她更渴望努力实现梦想。

交朋友、拍电影，还有更多！一子在神秘学社团的“外星人”中会遇见什么？一切取决于你！

（来源：[url=https://rosegardengames.itch.io/the-alien-of-the-occult-club]itch.io[/url]）
